'''Kwymar Six''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of ten [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that [[Skirmish in the Kwymar sector|fought]] in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]]. They were each armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. and the squad carried a tripod-mounted [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]].
